verdicts.reason: A: the three badge pills are pushed out to the canvas edges with large gaps, so they read as scattered pieces rather than one group, and the body copy runs to an overly long line. It does, however, keep the missing-asset placeholder clear of the legal line and leaves the legal text readable. B keeps the original's tighter, centred stack more faithfully, but the placeholder box sits on top of the end of the legal text, the legal line is shrunk to near-illegible size, and a sparkle dot lands on the body copy ('bottled').
